scope: Exact locked distributions; selected source or Linux/universal release artifact for license evidence. Native bundled subcomponents and runtime downloads require separate review.
review_status: Engineering artifact hashes verified; legal approval pending. No third-party payload is added by this inventory.
limitations: One selected artifact per locked distribution; not every platform wheel.
License metadata is recorded verbatim and is not a legal conclusion; review retained archive texts.
Build-system requirements setuptools>=77 and wheel are not pinned by these locks.
Browser binaries, distro packages, images, workloads and runtime symbols require their own exact-artifact records.
